meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: 它会先喊出 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED,再组建 5 名互相激烈攻击的评审成员,只保留经得起攻击的结论,交给专职规划者写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最大严谨度,或你要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批评式计划时触发;前提是团队工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 把我这份方案过一遍对抗评审
say.note: 先启动 5 人互攻评审,再交给规划者

say.text: 对这个计划做交叉批评,只保留活下来的结论
say.note: 被攻倒的结论会被剔除

say.text: 我要最大严谨度,用对抗式规划审我的迁移方案
say.note: 按 7 个阶段推进到正式计划

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member hostile team whose members cross-attack each other's findings; only defensible insights survive, and a dedicated planner formalizes them into the plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or when you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires the team tools to be available.

say_en.note: 5 hostile members critique, then a planner formalizes

say_en.text: Cross-critique this plan and keep only what survives
Use adversarial planning to review my migration plan
say_en.note: Runs 7 phases to a formal plan
